fields.name: Dr. Santanu Kumar Parida
fields.short_bio: Assistant Professor of Physics with research interests in materials physics, semiconductor materials, perovskite solar cells and emerging functional materials for energy applications.
fields.full_bio:
Dr. Santanu Kumar Parida is an Assistant Professor of Physics at Government Women’s College, Baripada, Odisha. His academic interests encompass materials physics, semiconductor materials, nanostructured materials and emerging functional materials for energy applications.

His research work focuses particularly on the synthesis, characterization and understanding of functional materials, with current interests in lead-free perovskite materials and their potential applications in photovoltaic devices. His research experience also includes studies of semiconductor materials, nanomechanical behaviour and surface phenomena.

Alongside research, he is actively engaged in undergraduate teaching and the development of academic resources in Physics. His academic activities include research publications, student mentoring, institutional academic initiatives and the development of research-oriented teaching and learning resources.
